# Piotr Spychalski, MD, PhD

> Colorectal surgeon and clinical researcher at the Medical University of Gdańsk, Poland (ORCID 0000-0001-7111-4660, Wikidata Q57611140). Research: colorectal cancer screening and colonoscopy quality (NordICC, Polish Colonoscopy Screening Program), organ-preserving treatment of early colorectal cancer (Horizon Europe ECOPOP: ETHOS, SCAR, T-REX), randomised trials in colorectal surgery (CORAL, Principal Investigator; STOP-HOS-1).

## Pages
- [Profile and selected publications](https://piotrspychalski.github.io/): biography, research areas, selected publications with DOIs
- [Informacje dla pacjentów (PL)](https://piotrspychalski.github.io/pl/): scope of clinical practice (colorectal cancer, robotic and laparoscopic colorectal surgery, diverticular disease, stoma, proctology), how patients reach him at the University Clinical Centre in Gdańsk (NFZ only, no private practice), recruiting clinical trials
